flow-definition.description: Weekly secrets rotation. Drives scripts/rotator/rotate.py against every target in manifest.json. db_bcrypt + keycloak_realm targets take effect immediately; env_var targets only update the snapshot — their consuming containers must be recreated separately. Archive of secrets/rotated/* + history JSON is attached to each build so prior rotations are recoverable via the build artifacts page.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TARGETS
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Comma-separated target names from manifest.json to rotate. Empty = all targets. Example: postgres-dashboard-admin,packagerepo-admin

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: DRY_RUN
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Show what would be rotated without writing. Recommended for the first run after a manifest change.
